about: Points tested against the country shapes of the map, and the areas they belong to. The areas are every record of Natural Earth's 1:10m layer of breakaway and disputed areas (version 5.1.1), each with its name, id and note as the layer's file spells them. The points are of three kinds: places of Natural Earth's populated-places file (version 5.1.2); for each area, a point inside its polygon that the atlas computed from the layer (mapshaper -points inner, one point per area, inside one part for an area of several parts); and two points that the atlas chose by hand. Two names begin with a byte order mark in the layer's file; the mark is dropped. Read 25 November 2026.
